text: Kestrel Analytics quarterly revenue in 2026: Q1 revenue was 4.2 million USD, Q2 revenue was 4.9 million USD, and Q3 revenue was 5.6 million USD.
Kestrel Analytics headcount by department: engineering has 48 employees, sales has 22 employees, and support has 15 employees.
Project Heron is the fraud-detection project at Kestrel Analytics. Its budget is 310,000 USD and its project lead is Meera Rao.
Project Osprey builds the customer dashboard at Kestrel Analytics. Its budget is 185,000 USD and its project lead is Daniel Okafor.
Project Plover is the data-cleaning tool at Kestrel Analytics. Its budget is 92,000 USD and its project lead is Sana Iqbal.
Kestrel Analytics opened its first office in Pune in 2019. Its second office, in Kochi, opened in 2023.
Kestrel Analytics customer churn rate was 3.1 percent in Q2 2026 and 2.7 percent in Q3 2026.
Kestrel Analytics support handled 1,105 tickets in August 2026 and 1,240 tickets in September 2026.
Industry analysts expect Kestrel Analytics to open an office in Chennai next year.
Hyderabad is the capital of Telangana, India. Its city population was about 6.9 million in the 2011 census.
LangGraph is a library for building stateful, graph-structured LLM agent workflows.
